parameters.name: AccountId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: Ensures the idempotency of the request. Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure that the value is unique across different requests. **ClientToken** supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: DedicatedClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the DTS dedicated cluster.

parameters.name: DtsJobId
parameters.description: The ID of the data migration or data synchronization task.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value must be a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of log entries per page. Default value: **20**.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start timestamp. If this parameter is not specified, data from the last seven days is returned by default. Unit: milliseconds (ms).
